name: Sunborn
source:
For the freedom of her pack, a she-wolf agrees to retrieve and deliver the only known sample of an antidote to vampirism. However, the truth hidden within an abandoned lab forces her to make an impossible choice: betray her humanity, or betray her own kind.
[From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Sunborn]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
translation:
为了换取族群的自由，一名母狼人答应前去寻回并护送已知唯一的一份吸血鬼化解药样本。然而，隐藏在废弃实验室深处的真相却迫使她面临两难抉择：背叛自己的人性，还是背叛自己的同族。
[摘自[url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Sunborn]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
